lines: You just highlighted a whole page, without reading a single word.
And I have no idea what you just studied.
So today, we're talking about active recall.
Active recall is pulling the answer out of your own head.
Rereading feels like studying. But your brain is just looking.
When you have to answer, your brain has to dig it back up. And digging is what makes it stick.
That's why a quick quiz beats a fourth reread.
Unspool turns your notes into short reels, with a quiz at the end of every one.
So every reel makes you pull it out. A few minutes a day.
